title: 30A Sunshine Shack | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* Spacious Home in Highland Parks* 3 King Bedrooms* Front Porch / Screened Back Porch / Screened Balcony / Patio * Bicycles (4) Included for Access to the Beach* 6-Seater Golf Cart Available for an Additional $50/night.
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* Spacious Home in Highland Parks* 3 King Bedrooms* Front Porch / Screened Back Porch / Screened Balcony / Patio * Bicycles (4) Included for Access to the Beach* 6-Seater Golf Cart Available for an Additional $50/night. * Blue Mountain Beach Access- 0.6 miles (Parking, Restrooms, and Seasonal Lifeguards)* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community Grilling Area, 360-Observation Tower* Close to Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center* Under 1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery* Close to Grayton Beach State Park (4 miles) and Seaside (5 miles)* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * *Occupancy is strictly enforced at 12 people maximum. No exceptions*30A Sunshine Shack is a 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath home in Highland Parks, located in laid-back Blue Mountain Beach, with the delicious Blue Mountain Beach Creamery nearby, offering homemade scoops, and within walking distance to shops in RedFish Village. The spacious kitchen boasts all stainless steel appliances and an eat-in bar. You will love mornings on the front patio and chasing the sunset from the balcony in the evenings. You'll create lifelong memories on the private back patio complete with a dining table and grill. With a king bed in both the master bedrooms, an additional king guest bedroom, a full guest bedroom, a twin bunk bed, and a twin bed with a twin trundle in another guest bedroom, this lovely home can sleep a total of 12 guests. Two of these bedrooms are also on the main floor, making your stay even more convenient. Come add a little 30A Sunshine Shack to your life!Take one of the 4 bikes provided and ride the bike trails down to Seaside, Watercolor, or Grayton Beach. Out the back of the home, head down Longleaf Pine Greenway hiking/biking trail 0.6 miles and dip your toes in the sugar sands of Blue Mountain Beach. Come have a vacation of a lifetime at 30A Sunshine Shack.Bed Setup:First Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed and private bathroomGuest Bedroom: Full BedSecond Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed and private bathroomGuest Bedroom: King Bed w/ shared bath with double vanityGuest Bedroom: Twin Bunkbed and Twin Bed w/ Twin Trundle (shared bath with double vanity)*Parking is only available for 2 vehicles in the home's designated paved driveway. Street parking is not allowed. Violations are strictly enforced by the HOA. Access to the garage is not allowed. *Highland Parks is the newest neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach, featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and is surrounded by great eateries and local, eclectic shops. Highland Parks is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites: Redfish Taco, Blue Mabel, Shunk Gulley, The Grove 30A, The Perfect Pig, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.AREA ATTRACTIONS: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in The Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous, but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
